decisions.reason: The COVID collapse in air travel left this mobile check-in app well below aspiration, and airlines' own apps crowd it out, so problemistic search points to moving its resources back to the core screening business.

PassBoard is a multi-model passenger processing line close to the firm's core aviation security competence, and the 2022 traffic recovery and demand for contactless processing make it worth carrying with the slack of a large firm.

Self-service check-in fits airports' post-pandemic push for touchless, efficient passenger flows and builds on established airline relationships, so despite weak early results it stays while the recovery shows whether it can meet aspirations.
